item.title: Being a good net citizen in the AI era: a guide to web discoverability
item.description: Search engines changed the web by indexing links. Now automated agents, RAG pipelines, and LLM search tools like Perplexity and Claude are crawling sites to answer user queries directly.

item.title: Archiving the web with Git: building a content-addressable crawler
item.description: Web pages disappear all the time. Companies delete docs during rebrands, terms of service change without changelogs, and links rot.

item.title: Can you use GitHub as a database? SQLite, HTTP range requests, and flat files
item.description: I often look for ways to keep side projects zero-maintenance and zero-cost, which made me wonder: can I just use GitHub as a persistent database?
